title: THES PTA Holiday Market 2026
tagline: Shop local makers, unique gifts, treats, and more — and support Thunder Hill Elementary.
summary: The Thunder Hill Elementary PTA Holiday Market is Saturday, November 21, 2026, 11 AM–3 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). Shop local makers and small businesses — vendor spaces available now.
flyer_alt: THES PTA Holiday Market 2026 flyer — Saturday, November 21, 2026, 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School. Vendor registration: $30 early bird until November 1, $40 from November 2 to 18, per 8 by 6 foot space.
about: Join us for a festive day of shopping, community, and small businesses! The THES PTA Holiday Market brings local artisans, crafters, bakers, and small businesses together under one roof — the perfect place to find one-of-a-kind holiday gifts while supporting our school.
Vendor fees go directly to the Thunder Hill Elementary PTA, helping fund programs for our students and teachers.

sections.heading: What You'll Find
items: Handmade and unique gifts from local makers
Art, jewelry, and holiday décor
Baked goods, treats, food, and beverages
Direct-sales favorites and small businesses from our community

sections.heading: Become a Vendor
items: Early bird: $30 per 8' × 6' space, through November 1
Standard: $40 per 8' × 6' space, November 2 – November 18
Only 40 spaces available — first come, first served
The first 20 vendors to register get a yard sign to advertise the market
You keep 100% of your sales — vendor fees go to the THES PTA
Vendors bring their own tables, chairs, and extension cords (the PTA can't supply these)
Vendor setup 9:30 – 11:00 AM · cleanup 3:00 – 4:00 PM
sections.note: We're looking for: Artists & artisans, crafters & makers, bakers, food & beverage vendors and food trucks, and direct-sales representatives (Scentsy, Tastefully Simple, Pampered Chef, Tupperware, Nailed It, and more).

title: THES Veterans Day Celebration 2026
tagline: Help us honor the veterans and military family members in our Thunder Hill community.
summary: Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County) honors its veteran and military families on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, with a photo slideshow and classroom visits.
flyer_alt: Veterans Day at THES flyer — Wednesday, November 11, 2026. THES will have a celebration for all veteran families, with a photo slideshow and classroom visits. To include a veteran or military family member, complete the Veterans/Military Submission form (QR code on the flyer) by October 25th. If you submitted your information last year, you do not need to submit it again. Questions: meagan_lesinski@hcpss.org.
about: Thunder Hill Elementary School will celebrate and honor our veteran and military families on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.
Families are invited to help us recognize the veterans and military family members in our community through our Veterans Day slideshow and classroom visits.

sections.heading: How to Take Part
items: Photo slideshow: honoring the veteran and military family members of our THES community
Classroom visit: veterans and military family members are welcome to visit classrooms, if available
Honor & celebrate: help us recognize the brave people in our THES community

sections.heading: Submissions Closed
items: The Veterans/Military Submission Form closed on October 25
Thank you to every family who shared a veteran or military family member

title: THES PTA Giving Tuesday 2026
eyebrow: Give a Little. Make a Big Difference!
tagline: This Giving Tuesday, help THES PTA keep creating the experiences and memories that make elementary school special.
summary: Giving Tuesday is Tuesday, December 1, 2026: an all-day online giving drive for the Thunder Hill Elementary School PTA in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). A donation of any size funds Fall Fest, Winter Wonderland, International Night, STEM Night, Field Day, teacher and staff appreciation, and more.
about: What does THES PTA do? We help create the experiences and memories that make elementary school special! From the excitement of Fall Fest and Trunk or Treat to the smiles at our Ice Cream Social, the magic of Winter Wonderland, and the celebration of cultures at International Night, THES PTA works throughout the year to bring meaningful experiences to our students and families.
We also support our incredible teachers and staff through appreciation activities and provide opportunities that enrich the school experience for everyone.

These are more than just events. They are opportunities for children to make friends, discover new interests, celebrate their school community, create lasting memories, and feel connected to something special.

sections.heading: What Your Gift Supports
items: Celebrate together at Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat
Enjoy our Welcome Back Ice Cream Social
Recognize and honor our veterans
Experience the magic of Winter Wonderland
Explore cultures and traditions at International Night
Discover, create, and learn at STEM Night
Show our appreciation for THES teachers and staff
Explore future possibilities at Career Day
Build memories and friendships at Field Day
Celebrate our planet on Earth Day
Enjoy community fun at Spring Fling
Celebrate the end of another wonderful school year

sections.heading: Give on Tuesday, December 1
items: Giving is online and open all day; donate from anywhere
Every contribution, big or small, helps us keep creating wonderful experiences for our students, teachers, staff, and families
We're also giving back on Giving Tuesday, with a thank-you for our THES teachers and staff
Your donation helps create the memories our children will carry with them long after elementary school
sections.note: Thank you for supporting THES PTA and our Thunder Hill community!

flyer_alt: Giving Tuesday flyer: Give a Little. Make a BIG Difference! Tuesday, Dec. 1, 2026. Support Thunder Hill Elementary School PTA! This Giving Tuesday, please consider making a donation to the Thunder Hill Elementary School PTA (THES PTA) to support the students, teachers, and staff at THES. THES PTA is a nonprofit organization that raises funds to provide meaningful experiences, enrichment opportunities, celebrations, and activities that bring our school community together throughout the year: Fall Fest & Trunk or Treat, Ice Cream Social, Veterans Day, Winter Wonderland, International Night, STEM Night, Teacher & Staff Appreciation, Career Day, Field Day, Earth Day, Spring Fling, End-of-Year Activities, and so much more! Every dollar makes a difference! Donate today: 1thes.givebacks.com/shop (QR code).
